propositions: Four core modules (applier, fetcher, apply_handlers, _attestation) contain nested lazy imports from adapters.jira that must be eliminated to satisfy epic bbf1 AC3 zero-import requirement.

Backend protocol must be extended with scalar, read-only members (project, query_project, assert_env_ready) and neutral exceptions (BackendEnvError, BackendAssigneeNotFoundError) to enable vendor-agnostic access to scope, configuration, and error semantics.

Rewiring the four modules to route through Backend instance or registry seam (select_backend) instead of direct Jira adapter calls preserves all existing fail-fast/fail-closed/soft-fail behaviors while breaking vendor coupling.
Full-tree AST walker (using ast.walk, not just tree.body) must verify no adapters.jira imports exist at any nesting depth in the four modules, including function-level lazy imports.

JiraBackend and S2 contract suite and FakeBackend must implement the widened Protocol to satisfy structural typing; ADR 0035 section (d) interface table must document new scalar members and exceptions for future backend implementors.
